visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an extreme close-up of a golden-brown, flaky pastry being pulled apart by two hands, revealing a thick, glossy chocolate cream filling that flows out like lava. A man with dark hair and a black jacket is visible in the soft-focus background, smiling broadly as he watches. The scene is set in an outdoor or semi-outdoor dining area with a glass-fronted building behind him reflecting interior lights. (2) The scene shifts to a man in a green plaid shirt walking toward the camera on a paved sidewalk outside a storefront with a black sign that reads 'PATISSERIE TEN.' He takes a large bite of a pastry filled with bright green cream. The camera then cuts to the interior of the bakery, showing rows of golden cream puffs on cooling trays and a glass display case filled with dark canelés and golden madeleines. A staff member in a white uniform is seen using a piping bag to inject cream into a puff. (3) The man in the green plaid shirt is now seated at an outdoor wooden table, holding a cream puff wrapped in white paper. He takes bites of different puffs, showing vanilla and green pistachio fillings. His facial expressions are highly animated, with wide eyes and open-mouthed gestures of delight. The lighting is natural daylight mixed with warm artificial light from the shop interior. Yellow and white captions frequently appear at the bottom and center of the frame. (4) In the final phase, the man is seen wearing a grey beanie and a black hoodie, holding a dark blue shopping bag with 'PATISSERIE TEN' printed on it. He stands outside the shop, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied expression. The video concludes with a static shot of the storefront entrance and a text overlay providing the shop's address and contact information in Japanese and English.
